about: Tail postures of the rigged mammals (lane SIG-OTHER), built by scripts/ark-tail-postures.mts from the species catalogue (AnimalDex docs/ark/signature-behaviours.json): only what a species' own stored text says. when: always, while moving (the locomotion layer's motion), or while it signals socially (the scene's: it looks at another animal or the camera, or is at play). pitch: radians each tail link holds at full hold (up positive); idle: the share kept when not held; wag: the yaw swing of each link at full social strength and its rate (Hz). line = the species' own sentence, said in the live log while it is drawn.

domestic-dog.name: Domestic Dog
domestic-dog.quote: Tail wagged or raised as a social signal
domestic-dog.line: {aAnimal} is wagging its tail as a signal

south-american-coati.name: South American Coati
south-american-coati.quote: Raised ringed tail: the tail works like a visible group flag while moving.
south-american-coati.line: {aAnimal} is walking with its ringed tail raised like a flag

eastern-chipmunk.name: Eastern Chipmunk
eastern-chipmunk.quote: Tail held straight up when running
eastern-chipmunk.line: {aAnimal} is running with its tail held straight up

hamadryas-baboon.name: Hamadryas Baboon
hamadryas-baboon.quote: Tail held in an arch, ending in a small tuft
hamadryas-baboon.line: {aAnimal} is holding its tail in an arch, ending in a small tuft

olive-baboon.name: Olive Baboon
olive-baboon.quote: Tail bent sharply near the base, then hanging down
olive-baboon.line: {aAnimal} is carrying its tail bent sharply near the base, then hanging down

toque-macaque.name: Toque Macaque
toque-macaque.quote: Tail as long as the body, carried in an S or C
toque-macaque.line: {aAnimal} is carrying its long tail in an S shape

skipped.Prevost's Squirrel: quick dashes with fr: its quote gives the dashes and pauses, not an arched tail
skipped.Tayra: bounds with back arched and tail: the tail held out is the rig's rest pose; the arched back is a body clip
skipped.Giraffe: flicks tufted tail against flie: its rig has no tail bones
